title: {{provider}} Bump Reminder
reminderTextNoCommand:
You can now bump this server again!
-# If the bump bot doesn't respond with a bump confirmation, click the button below.
tooEarly: Please bump the server first. This button is only for when the bump bot doesn't respond. It unlocks {{unlock}}.

settings.overviewDescription: Reminds your community when the server can be bumped again. Add one entry per bump bot: start from a template, or point it at any bot yourself.

descriptions.active: Whether this bump reminder is enabled
descriptions.name: Shown in the reminder heading. Defaults to a generic label
descriptions.template: Fills in a known bump bot's settings for you. You can edit everything afterwards.
descriptions.botId: The bot whose message counts as a successful bump
descriptions.cooldownSeconds: How long until the server can be bumped again, e.g. `2h` or `3h 50m`
descriptions.commandName: The command people should run, without the slash (e.g. `bump`)
descriptions.commandId: Optional. Makes the command clickable in the reminder. Right-click the command in Discord and copy its ID.
descriptions.matchSource: Which part of the bot's message to search
descriptions.matchText: The reminder starts when the chosen part contains this text. Case is ignored.
descriptions.channel: The channel reminders are sent in. Defaults to the channel the bump happened in
descriptions.deleteReply: Delete the bump bot's confirmation message shortly after the bump
descriptions.roles: Roles to ping with the reminder
descriptions.users: Users to ping with the reminder
descriptions.repeatEnabled: Send another reminder if no-one bumps
descriptions.repeatReminder: How long to wait before repeating the reminder

reasons.repeatOnly: Only shown while repeating is enabled

settings.deleteBlocked: Turn this bump reminder off before deleting it.

guide.title: Bump Reminders Setup Guide
guide.intro: Pick the bump bot, tell Ayako how its confirmation looks, choose who gets pinged, then enable it. The first bump does the rest.
guide.advertText: **New here?** The Setup Guide walks you through the bump reminder options.

errors.notEnabled: Bump reminders are not enabled in this server.
errors.matchRequired: Tell Ayako what text marks a successful bump.
errors.cooldownTooShort: Enter a duration of at least 1 minute.
